content.comment_body: Hello, I have a [product_name] module and a 4-20 mA pressure transmitter sensor, which I've connected using a 500 ohm resistor. This setup provides a 2-10 V DC signal to the controller. I would like to convert (scale) the 2-10 V DC input to represent a 0-10 bar range. What is the correct way to scale the voltage input so it maps to 0-10 bar? Appreciate any help. Split from analog input scaling for [product_name].

analysis.insight_summary: A user asked for advice on scaling a 2-10 V DC analog input (from a 4-20 mA pressure sensor and resistor setup) to display a 0-10 bar value within a [product_name] module. Another user suggested checking the configuration in the software, implying the scaling can be set up directly via the programming interface. The discussion highlights an expectation for built-in, user-friendly software options for analog input scaling.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for straightforward instructions or a built-in tool to convert a voltage input range into a calibrated pressure range matching real measurement units.
